task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: First navigate to the box stack and pick the top box BOX_TOP. Then navigate to the temp table and place BOX_TOP there. Then navigate back to the box stack and pick BOX_MIDDLE. Then navigate to the inspection table and place BOX_MIDDLE there. Finally, navigate back to the temp table, pick BOX_TOP, and place it back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack minus the middle box.
assumptions: The robot can navigate to each target location precisely.
Objects are graspable at their current locations within robot interaction distance.
BOX_TOP is currently on top of the stack and can be picked first.
TEMP_TABLE is a suitable temporary location to hold BOX_TOP.
After placing BOX_TOP on BOX_BOTTOM, the stack will have BOX_BOTTOM at bottom and BOX_TOP on top, effectively removing BOX_MIDDLE.
